features.title: Event system content import
features.benefit: Pull exhibitors, sessions and speakers automatically from an external event management system.
features.what: Exhibitors, sessions and speakers sync from an external event management system, configured per event. Exhibitors are matched by account number and kept up to date, and main contacts are added as admin team members.
features.detail: Exhibitors, sessions and speakers sync from the external system, configured per event, with exhibitors matched by account number and main contacts added as admin team members.
stories: Integration with ASP events system to pull in Exhibitors, Sessions and Speakers

features.title: Visit badge and scanner integration
features.benefit: Use Visit digital badges and the Visit lead scanner inside the platform, with scanned leads pulled back in.
features.what: Organisers can switch on the Visit digital badge and Visit lead scanner for web and app, sync leads scanned in Visit into the platform, and choose email or external ID to match accounts.
features.detail: Organisers can switch on the external Visit badge and lead scanner for web and app, sync leads scanned in Visit into the platform, and choose email or external ID as the matching identifier.
stories: Visit G2 pull external leads to EP

features.title: Meeting data in the public API
features.benefit: Retrieve full meeting data through the public API, including incremental updates since your last sync.
features.what: A paginated public API endpoint returns every meeting with the same fields as the meetings export, filterable by account and time. Session responses include the exhibitor ID, and API stand changes move pre-scheduled meetings.
features.detail: A paginated endpoint returns every meeting with the same fields as the meetings export, with filters by account and time and sort options. Session responses include the exhibitor ID for exhibitor events, updating an exhibitor's hall and stand also moves their pre-scheduled meetings, and the account interactions endpoint was documented.
stories: API endpoints int the public API to pull out meeting data in its entirety
Account Interactions public endpoint. Formatting changes + doc
Replacing the halls and stand numbers for exhibitor via API parameters should replace the pre-scheduled existing meetings with the new Halls & stand numbers
Add additional filter param for /api/v2/meetings/export endpoint to fetch incremental updates
Exhibitor Id need to add from session export file, /api/v2/sessions/getSession  and /api/v2/sessions/get API resposne for Exhibitor events

features.title: ExpoFP floor plan integration
features.benefit: Show the interactive ExpoFP floor plan on the event site, with search, deep links and wayfinding.
features.what: Organisers switch on the ExpoFP floor plan with an account token. Attendees search exhibitors, custom locations and sessions, including in-person sessions and exhibitor events, with deep links and wayfinding.
features.detail: Enabled with an account token, the ExpoFP floor plan lets attendees search exhibitors, custom locations and sessions, including in-person sessions and exhibitor events with a physical location.
stories: ExpoFP || Add field for account token

features.title: Reach5 login for buyer registration
features.benefit: Let returning buyers log in with their Reach5 account in the buyer registration pop-up.
features.what: Reach5 login is available in the buyer registration pop-up used on the repeat-registration link.
features.detail: Reach5 login was added to the buyer registration pop-up used on the repeat-registration link.
stories: Please add reach 5 settings functionality to the EP internal buyer registration pop up for all buyers to register using EP reg link

features.title: Klipso integration
features.benefit: Import exhibitors from Klipso automatically, with categories and custom questions kept up to date.
features.what: The platform pulls exhibitor data from Klipso every minute or on demand with a Sync button, maps categories by text, imports chosen exhibitor custom questions and passes contact email and username.
features.detail: The integration pulls exhibitor data from Klipso every minute or on demand with a Sync button, maps categories by text, brings in chosen exhibitor custom questions and passes contact email and username.
stories: Build an integration between EP and Klipso
Klipso Integration - Addition of two parameters
Klipso Integration - Addition of Custom Questions

features.title: Public API improvements
features.benefit: Do more through the public API, from exporting buyers to creating products with image links.
features.what: The API offers a buyers-only export, product images as URLs, speaker and moderator ID arrays on sessions, 'Other' locations for exhibitor events, the indoor maps toggle and activity category limits on profile edits.
features.detail: A buyers-only export is available through the API, product images can be sent as URLs, session responses include speakers and moderators, exhibitor event 'Other' locations can be set, the indoor maps toggle is exposed and activity category limits can be set when editing profiles.
stories: Accept URL for the images[] field for /api/v2/product/set endpoint
Text Field for "Other"  option in Session Location for Exhibitor events is missing in Imports and API
Include value of MapsPeople "Enable" toggle to the API
Edit profile add activity category limit from API

features.title: Aditus badges in the app
features.benefit: Show attendees their Aditus tickets on the badge page of the mobile app.
features.what: When the Aditus badge integration is on, the app's badge menu lists the user's Aditus tickets, found by email, each opening its badge page, with screens for not found and offline.
features.detail: When the Aditus badge integration is switched on, the app's badge menu lists the user's Aditus tickets, found by email.
stories: Custom Badge Page Integration with Aditus

features.title: CRM session import
features.benefit: Import sessions and speakers from an organiser's own CRM, along with their tracks, types and tags.
features.what: An integration with an organiser's own CRM, switched on in event setup, pulls sessions and speakers into the agenda with their tracks, types and tags.
features.detail: An integration with an organiser's own CRM, switched on in event setup, pulls sessions and speakers into the agenda with their tracks, types and tags.

features.title: Event system import enhancements
features.benefit: Control which sessions, speakers and exhibitor details are imported from the external event system.
features.what: Imports bring in moderators, only the speakers of imported sessions, exhibitor custom fields and categories, tracks and session types, and filter sessions by stream and seminar name. Fields can be locked and welcome emails sent.
features.detail: Imports now bring in moderators, only the speakers of imported sessions, exhibitor custom fields and categories, tracks and session types, and can filter sessions by stream and seminar name. Fields can be locked from updates and welcome emails sent to imported exhibitors.
stories: ASP Exhibitor Integration - Send Email Functionality

features.title: ExpoFP exhibitor data sync
features.benefit: Keep ExpoFP floor plans current with exhibitor details sent automatically from the platform.
features.what: Exhibitor name, stand, order ID, description, logo and category are sent to ExpoFP whenever an exhibitor is created, edited or deleted, with changes grouped and sent together every ten minutes.
features.detail: Exhibitor name, stand, order ID, description, logo and category are pushed to ExpoFP whenever an exhibitor changes, with changes grouped and sent together every ten minutes.
stories: Gather exhibitor changes and send them to the ExpoFP together once in 10 minutes

features.title: Public API improvements
features.benefit: Set networking opt-in, filter statistics by time and export meeting tags through the public API.
features.what: The account endpoint accepts a networking opt-in, statistics endpoints filter by Unix timestamps, meeting locations follow stand changes sent by API, and meeting tags appear in the meetings export and endpoint.
features.detail: The account endpoint accepts a networking opt-in parameter, statistics endpoints filter by Unix timestamps, stand transmission via the API was improved and meeting tags appear in the meetings export and its endpoint.
stories: Add Networking Opt IN/OUT parameter to the /api/v2/account/set endpoint
Add time filter to API request of /api/v2/statistics/accountsInteractions and /api/v2/statistics/pageVisits
Improve transmission of exhibitor stands to the EP via API, so remain posibility to replace them
Expose Meeting Tags in Export & API

features.title: Crowd Connected location and messaging
features.benefit: Send location-based push messages through Crowd Connected and link app users to their location data.
features.what: The apps pass each user's ID to Crowd Connected, which can send notifications with category targeting through a dedicated API. ExpoFP and Crowd Connected settings can be entered when an app is created.
features.detail: The apps pass each user's ID to Crowd Connected, Crowd Connected can send notifications with category targeting through a dedicated API, and ExpoFP and Crowd Connected settings can be entered when an app is created.
stories: Pass User ID through to Crowd Connected
Push messaging through Crowd Connected on app

features.title: Reach5 accounts at registration
features.benefit: Let visitors register with an existing Reach5 account, with their details carried across.
features.what: Visitor registration checks an email against both the platform and Reach5, logs in known users and creates platform accounts from Reach5 data.
features.detail: Visitor registration checks an email against both systems and creates platform accounts from Reach5 data.
stories: Autologged in mode + Reach 5 in EP Registration - VinExpo

features.title: Public API exhibitor and product controls
features.benefit: Switch an exhibitor's sponsor pop-up and activate or deactivate products through the public API.
features.what: The exhibitor endpoint accepts a sponsor pop-up parameter, and the product endpoint accepts an active or inactive status.
features.detail: The exhibitor endpoint accepts a sponsor pop-up parameter, and the product endpoint accepts an active or inactive status.

features.title: A2Z integration enhancements
features.benefit: Choose which A2Z exhibitors to import by booth status and map their pavilion and hall.
features.what: The A2Z integration imports only exhibitors with a selected booth status, and maps pavilion and hall codes to chosen custom fields.
features.detail: Only exhibitors with the selected booth status are imported, and pavilion and hall codes map to chosen custom fields.

features.title: Reach5 single sign-on
features.benefit: Let attendees sign in with Reach5 single sign-on.
features.what: The event site accepts a Reach5 authorisation code and exchanges it for an access token, logging the participant in and taking them to their dashboard.
features.detail: The site accepts a Reach5 authorisation code and exchanges it for an access token to log the user in.

features.title: Visit staff sign-on and meeting rights
features.benefit: Let exhibitors register their staff through single sign-on and control who can have meetings from Visit data.
features.what: A 'Register Your Staff' item under Team Members signs exhibitor admins into the partner registration system. A custom question and response set in the Visit integration decides which participants can have meetings.
features.detail: A 'Register Your Staff' option under Team Members signs exhibitor admins into the partner system, and a custom question and response set in the Visit integration decides which participants can have meetings.

features.title: Aditus participant sync
features.benefit: Sync participants and team members from Aditus for one or more events.
features.what: Participants and team members are pulled from Aditus for one or more events, with category mapping, badge fields and email options. The Aditus badge page settings are back in the admin panel.
features.detail: Registrations are pulled from Aditus with category mapping, badge fields and email options, and the Aditus badge page settings are available again in the admin panel.
stories: Custom Badge Page with Aditus - Reinstate the Settings on Admin Panel

features.title: Klipso integration enhancements
features.benefit: Bring exhibitor admins, multiple stands and product categories across from Klipso.
features.what: Klipso contact person details become the exhibitor's admin team member, optionally active on arrival. Exhibitors can have several halls and stands, and product categories can be copied from an earlier event.
features.detail: Contact person details become the exhibitor's admin team member, optionally set as active, exhibitors can have several halls and stands, and product categories can be copied from an earlier event.
stories: Klipso Native Integration - Status change on Team Member Admin
Klipso Native Integration - Exhibitor Product Categories Enhancement

features.title: Public API improvements
features.benefit: Filter meeting exports by creation and change dates, remove team members and fetch badge QR codes through the API.
features.what: The meetings export filters by creation and last-modified dates, sending empty exhibitor IDs detaches a team member from an exhibitor, and the account endpoint returns the participant's badge QR code.
features.detail: The meetings export accepts created and last-modified date filters, sending empty exhibitor IDs detaches a team member, and the account endpoint returns the participant's badge QR code.
stories: Badge QR - Exposing it to the api/v2/account/get

features.title: Event system data push-back
features.benefit: Send exhibitors, news and exhibitor content from the platform back to the external event system.
features.what: Exhibitors in selected categories, approved news and exhibitor manual brochures, images and videos are sent from the platform to the external event system with an agreed field mapping, including product export columns.
features.detail: Exhibitors in selected categories, approved news and exhibitor manual brochures, images and videos flow to the external system with an agreed field mapping, including product export columns.

features.title: Participant and exhibitor list endpoints
features.benefit: Fetch all participants and exhibitors through paginated API v2 endpoints, or only what changed since a given time.
features.what: New API v2 endpoints list all participants and all exhibitors with their details, including parent and child companies, with pagination and timestamp filters. Deleted participant IDs can also be retrieved.
features.detail: New endpoints list participants and exhibitors with their details, including parent and child companies, with timestamp filters. Deleted participant IDs can also be retrieved.
stories: API V1 Visitors list Migration to API V2
API V1 Synchronize data Migration to API V2

features.title: Public API v3
features.benefit: Start building on the new Public API v3, beginning with events, categories and registration questions.
features.what: The first Public API v3 endpoints list an environment's events, the exhibitor and participant categories of an event, and the custom questions of the visitor registration pipeline.
features.detail: The first v3 endpoints list an environment's events, exhibitor and participant categories, and the custom questions of the visitor registration pipeline.
stories: Accounts - New Endpoint on API V3

features.title: Visit integration on API V2
features.benefit: Sync participants and exhibitors with Visit in near real time, with automatic retries and full request logs.
features.what: The Visit integration moved to Visit's API v2. It receives updates as they happen, pushes chosen fields back, runs an end-of-day push, handles deletions, syncs profile pictures both ways, retries failed calls and logs every request.
features.detail: The integration moved to Visit's V2 API, receives updates as they happen, pushes chosen fields back and runs an end-of-day push. Deletions are handled, profile pictures sync both ways, failed calls retry automatically and every request is logged in the admin panel.
stories: HYVE - N200 API V2. New version on N200 using V2
HYVE - N200 API V2. Handles of deletes
HYVE - N200 API V2. Sync from EP to GES
HYVE - N200 API V2. New logs
HYVE - N200 API V2. Error handling and automation
N200 Addition of Profile Picture for accounts
Profile Picture sync in GES/Visit integration

features.title: Genesis World integration
features.benefit: Connect the platform with the Genesis World CRM.
features.what: The first phase of a native integration with the Genesis World CRM was delivered, connecting it with the platform.
features.detail: The first phase of a native integration with Genesis World was delivered.

features.title: Map Your Show integration
features.benefit: Import exhibitors from Map Your Show, with custom fields and product categories.
features.what: Built on the integration hub, the Map Your Show integration fetches exhibitors from the Map Your Show API with their custom fields, and maps product categories from an uploaded Excel file. A second stage completed the remaining scope.
features.detail: Built on the integration hub, the integration fetches exhibitors from the Map Your Show API with their custom fields and product categories, and a second stage completed the remaining requirements.

features.title: Integration hub mapping improvements
features.benefit: Map more data through the integration hub, including team member roles, default language and Aditus exhibitor data.
features.what: Team member roles can be set in the integration hub mapping, and existing admins keep their role on resync. Exhibitor mappings include a default language field, and exhibitor and team member admin data can be pushed to Aditus.
features.detail: Team member roles can be set in the mapping without downgrading existing admins on resync, exhibitor mappings include a default language field, and exhibitor and team member data can be pushed to Aditus.
stories: Aditus - Exhibitor and Team member data push
Add team member role matching to the mapping schema
Native Integration Hub - Addition of new field

features.title: More Public API v3 endpoints
features.benefit: Check accounts, read registration questions, export meetings and pull check-in data through Public API v3.
features.what: New v3 endpoints check whether an account exists, return visitor and exhibitor registration questions, export meetings with filters and incremental sync, and provide check-in data. The API rejects new accounts that use an admin's email.
features.detail: New v3 endpoints check whether an account exists, return visitor and exhibitor registration custom questions, export meetings with filters and incremental sync, and provide check-in data. The API also no longer creates an account with an email already used by an admin.
stories: GET - Check if the Account exists in the environment
GET - Visitor Registration Pipeline Custom Questions
GET - Exhibitor Registration Pipeline Custom Questions
Super Admins - Emails can be used when creating accounts using the API

features.title: Public API v3 content endpoints
features.benefit: Pull sponsors, products, floor plan halls and stands, session metadata and reference data through Public API v3.
features.what: New v3 endpoints return sponsors and sponsor categories, products, and event floor plan halls and stands. Session tracks, types, tags, languages, countries and regions follow, with localisation, sorting, paging and modified-since filters.
features.detail: New v3 endpoints return sponsors and sponsor categories, products filtered by exhibitor, and event-scoped floor plan halls and stands. Session tracks, types, tags and languages, countries and regions follow with localisation, sorting, paging and modified-since filters.
stories: Exhibitors - New Endpoint on API V3
API V3 - [GET] /api/v3/events/{eventId}/products (New Endpoint - Not present in V2)

features.title: CDS participant integration
features.benefit: Sync large volumes of registrations from CDS reliably.
features.what: Participants are pulled from CDS page by page with full field mapping, matched by email for updates, with order type and included items set in the admin panel.
features.detail: Participants are pulled from CDS page by page with full field mapping, matched by email for updates, with order type and included items set in the admin panel.

features.title: D2i integration
features.benefit: Import registration and attendee data from D2i automatically.
features.what: A native integration searches and pages through D2i registrations and syncs only changed records into the platform, with D2i as the source of truth.
features.detail: A native integration searches and pages through D2i registrations and syncs only changed records, with D2i as the source of truth.

features.title: Integrations move to the integration hub
features.benefit: Run the Aventri, Aditus and A2Z integrations on the integration hub.
features.what: The Aventri V2, Aditus and A2Z integrations were moved to the integration hub, keeping their current functions and default field mapping. A2Z now uses the newer REST API.
features.detail: The Aventri V2, Aditus and A2Z integrations were migrated to the integration hub.

features.title: Integrations catalogue
features.benefit: See every available integration in one catalogue in the admin panel, with its category and status for your event.
features.what: A new Integrations page in the admin panel lists hub and existing integrations with descriptions, category tags and whether each is active for the event. SAML 2.0 settings have their own page in the catalogue.
features.detail: A new Integrations page lists hub and existing integrations with descriptions, category tags and whether each is active for the event. SAML 2.0 settings now have their own page in the catalogue.
stories: Integrations catalog: move SAML 2.0 settings to a dedicated integration page (urgent – DLG)

features.title: API sponsor analytics and session filters
features.benefit: Read sponsor interaction analytics and set custom session filters through the public API.
features.what: A new endpoint returns sponsor views, clicks, favourites, meetings and messages. Session endpoints can set and return up to five custom filters, matched in the request language.
features.detail: A new endpoint returns sponsor views, clicks, favourites, meetings and messages, and session endpoints can set and return up to five custom filters.
stories: [Open API V2] New endpoint for "sponsor" analytics for accounts
API V2 — Add filter_1 to filter_5 support on sessions/set
API V2 — Return filter_1 to filter_5 on sessions/get and sessions/getSession

features.title: More reliable integration syncing
features.benefit: Keep partner data in step with self-healing sync, sync history and email-first matching.
features.what: ExpoFP and Visit run on the integration hub's automatic update engine, with removed exhibitors recreated, sync history, logs and a set polling interval. An 'Email First' option keeps profiles together when an email changes upstream.
features.detail: ExpoFP and Visit now run on the hub's automatic update engine, with removed exhibitors recreated, sync history and logs, and a configurable polling interval. An 'Email First' matching option keeps attendee profiles together when their email changes upstream.
stories: VISIT Native Integration - Updates on Sync Mechanism
Integration Hub - Change on Matching Mechanism

features.title: Product management in Public API v3
features.benefit: Create, update and delete products across all events through the API, including their images, videos and media.
features.what: New v3 endpoints create global products, update their global fields, delete a product from every event in one call, and upload or remove images, videos and media files, keeping image order and the main image.
features.detail: New v3 endpoints create global products, update global fields, delete a product from every event in one call, and upload or remove images, videos and media files, keeping image order and the main image.
stories: API V3 - [POST] /api/v3/products (Create global product, no event relation)
API V3 - [DELETE] /api/v3/products/{id} (Delete product globally, cascades all event relations)
API V3 - [POST] /api/v3/products/{id}/images (Upload product image from a file or a URL)

features.title: Swoogo integration
features.benefit: Sync registrants, speakers and exhibitors from Swoogo automatically, including cancellations.
features.what: An inbound Swoogo integration on the integration hub syncs registrants, speakers and exhibitors, including cancellations, matching records by external ID, grouping exhibitors by company and keeping team members linked.
features.detail: The inbound integration runs on the integration hub, matches records by external ID, groups exhibitors by company and keeps team members linked.
